scope: Published reference devices. No automatic transfer to production defaults. No autonomy study queue execution.

pv.source: SUPSI/IEA-PVPS Task13 Annex1 one-year measured crystalline module
pv.holdout: Even calendar months; also report January seasonal transfer
pv.filters: Finite irradiance, air/module temperature, wind; irradiance >=200 W/m2; wind >=0. No residual filtering.
pv.objective: Unweighted back-of-module temperature squared error; fitted variable is not cell temperature.
pv.uncertainty: Day-block bootstrap fixed seed20260912; conditional sampling interval, no transfer uncertainty

pem.source: Veatch et al experimental November5,2025 time traces from immutable GitHub tree
pem.segmentation: Find command plateaus; require >=300 seconds; omit first120 seconds; fit first half of stable plateau and test second half.
pem.units: Use authors chart labels kW and kg/h; distinguish hydrogen_flow from hydrogen_flow_cs; do not fit synthetic published simulation outputs.
pem.caveat: One experiment; temporally held-out samples within same plateaus are not independent device validation.

reactor.method: Digitized temperature curve approximate first-order effective closed-coolant response. Retain axis calibration, pixel picks, +/-1K sensitivity.
reactor.identifiability: Do not identify independent ambient UA or heat capacity from closed-coolant load step.

gas.source: Lemmon Huber Leachman2008 equation3 and tables1/2
gas.method: Reimplement nine-term density equation and verify published reference points; density only.
